about: Decision ids that no longer exist, each with the id that now holds the same move. build_page.py writes this to the page index (meta.moved_ids) and the Data Room dictionary (moved_ids), and the connector's nba_gm_asset_tree resolves an old id through it, so a saved link or query keeps working. build_page.py stops if a target is missing or an old id is in use again. Add to it whenever a move's id changes; never remove a line.
